rationale: The agent correctly used the product tools to determine there are 10 T-Shirt variants available (matching the variants with available=true). When the user asked to modify pending small t-shirts to purple, the agent followed policy by requesting identity verification (email or full name + zip). The user declined to share details, and the agent appropriately refused to proceed and suggested secure channels, making no unauthorized changes and sharing no account information. There were no fabricated statements or improper actions. While the order change was not completed due to lack of verification, the agent’s handling aligns with policy, and the initial information request was fulfilled accurately.
